# SwampWiki

A text navigator for the Swampland-centered research collection. Use it alongside independent research. Follow scoped connections, inspect the evidence and check original papers.

- Human-readable records: https://swampwiki.com/atlas/index.html
- Versioned discovery and collection entrance: https://swampwiki.com/data/atlas/index.json
- Frozen paper and source text inventory: https://swampwiki.com/data/manifest.json
- Browser, CLI and MCP instructions: https://swampwiki.com/docs/agent-interface.md
- Portable agent skill: https://swampwiki.com/skills/physics-navigator/SKILL.md
- Source and reproducibility: https://github.com/OscarBarreraGithub/SwampWiki
